shortDescription: List extracted values for a Semaphore integration

options.name: api_token
options.description: Bearer API token used for authentication. Use this or O(session_cookie).

options.name: host
options.description: Base URL of the Semaphore server, including the scheme. Example: C(http://localhost).

options.name: integration_id
options.description: Numeric ID of the integration whose extraction rules should be listed.

options.name: port
options.description: TCP port where the Semaphore API is exposed.

options.name: project_id
options.description: Numeric ID of the project that owns the integration.

options.name: session_cookie
options.description: Session cookie used for authentication. Use this or O(api_token).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate TLS certificates when using HTTPS.
